commands.name: help
commands.description: List available commands or explain one registered command.
commands.certification_implications: None; command discovery produces no certification evidence.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the Fortress CLI implementation version.
commands.certification_implications: None; implementation identity output is not certification evidence.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Build and evaluate a stabilized repository snapshot.
commands.certification_implications: Produces deterministic development audit evidence only; it is not Fortress certification.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Evaluate progressive finding enforcement without rewriting conformance.
commands.certification_implications: Applies authored baseline and exception authority only to blocking behavior; raw rule violations remain failed conformance and certification evidence.

commands.name: findings
commands.description: List current stable finding identities and lifecycle governance.
commands.certification_implications: Reports finding identity, lifecycle, disposition, and enforcement without changing raw conformance or producing certification evidence.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Preview anchored baseline adoption, comparable retirement and retained lifecycle evidence.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only proposal or explicit-time review; raw findings and active governance are unchanged. Protected application requires the existing trusted AUTHORITY boundary.
commands.usage: fortress baseline capture|create|review|prune [path] [--from state --to state] [--finding ID] [--format human|json]

commands.name: exceptions
commands.description: Inspect or propose exact finding-specific exception review and retirement.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only proposal or explicit-time review; raw findings and active governance are unchanged. Protected application requires the existing trusted AUTHORITY boundary.
commands.usage: fortress exceptions list|review|create|retire [exact IDs and review policy] [path] [--format human|json]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Discover and explicitly apply snapshot-bound minimal repository governance.
commands.certification_implications: Discovery produces no authority or certification evidence; explicit apply materializes only reviewed canonical authority, and optional baseline creation changes progressive enforcement without changing raw conformance.

commands.name: modules
commands.description: Inspect declared Module contracts, logical source bindings, and analysis-only ownership.
commands.certification_implications: Reports authored and mechanical ownership distinctly; it creates no Module intent or certification evidence.

commands.name: affected
commands.description: Explain exact-snapshot semantic invalidation and reusable results.
commands.certification_implications: Reports invalidation and reuse proof only; cache state creates no conformance or certification authority.

commands.name: ccg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Contract Coherency Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders derived semantic intent and coherency only; it is not certification evidence.

commands.name: bfg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Intended Behavioral Flow Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders intended Feature behavior only; it is not implementation realization or certification evidence.

commands.name: realized-bfg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Realized Behavioral Flow Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders coverage-aware intended-to-implementation reconciliation only; it is not a runtime trace, Verified BFG, or certification evidence.

commands.name: psm
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Program Semantic Model.
commands.certification_implications: Renders observed executable structure only; it is not behavioral realization, function correctness, or certification evidence.

commands.name: semantic
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic function-domain analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported abstract-domain consequences and explicit uncertainty only; it is not total program safety or certification evidence.

commands.name: state-effect
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic state and effect analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported typestate and effect consequences plus explicit uncertainty only; it is not total heap safety, external-system proof, or certification evidence.

commands.name: semantic-conformance
commands.description: Evaluate declared Module semantic policy against causal effect evidence.
commands.certification_implications: Renders authored policy, observed effect/capability consequences, causal evidence, and raw conformance separately; it does not infer permission or replace certification.

commands.name: information-flow
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic information-flow analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported trust/confidentiality propagation, sink contradictions, trusted transitions, and explicit uncertainty only; it is not comprehensive security proof or certification evidence.

commands.name: flow-author
commands.description: Preview a bounded operation source/sink policy using readable names.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only schema guidance or explicit immutable source preparation and proposal; no project-code execution, authority acceptance, certification proof or state repair.

commands.name: environmental
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic environmental analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders modeled external outcomes, handling totality, retry/idempotency, and bounded recovery consequences plus explicit uncertainty only; it is not comprehensive fault-tolerance proof or certification evidence.

commands.name: certify
commands.description: Execute local verification and certify the exact source snapshot.
commands.certification_implications: Executes the canonical local Rust suite, constructs the content-addressed Evidence DAG, and emits deterministic Certification and Verified BFG artifacts for the exact recursion-free source identity.

commands.name: source-artifacts
commands.description: Compile and render the language-neutral Source Artifact Model.
commands.certification_implications: Renders derived file responsibility, registered Rust profile/archetype coverage, lightweight semantic references, and structural findings; it does not provide a separate certificate or compiler-semantic proof.

commands.name: references
commands.description: Resolve stable Module identities and preview relocation-transparent path churn.
commands.certification_implications: Renders current physical projections and non-mutating relocation impact; certification separately proves artifact freshness.

commands.name: migrate-identities
commands.description: Preview or explicitly apply unambiguous legacy semantic identity migrations.
commands.certification_implications: Rewrites only exact-snapshot unambiguous authored legacy symbol and finding references after explicit apply; it creates no semantic or certification authority.

commands.name: declare
commands.description: Render a truthful multidimensional application declaration.
commands.certification_implications: Reports application semantics only; no implementation qualification or test execution is synthesized.

commands.name: assess
commands.description: Assess exact selected application profiles without inventing test execution.
commands.certification_implications: Reports application semantics only; no implementation qualification or test execution is synthesized.

commands.name: state-view
commands.description: Render a neutral governed, partial, negative, invalid or ungoverned endpoint.
commands.certification_implications: Reports application semantics only; no implementation qualification or test execution is synthesized.

commands.name: evidence
commands.description: Normalize retained JUnit or SARIF observations without executing project code.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only normalization retains unverified producer status; it neither executes project code nor grants profile approval.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Inspect selected governance, source freshness and independent result dimensions.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only projection of existing immutable results; no verification execution, certification, authority acceptance or repair.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose inputs, environment, evidence and storage without running or repairing project code.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only projection of existing immutable results; no verification execution, certification, authority acceptance or repair.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Query immutable Module policy and directed governance relationships.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only projection of existing immutable results; no verification execution, certification, authority acceptance or repair.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain recorded findings, claims, obligations and defeaters with paged evidence.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only projection of existing immutable results; no verification execution, certification, authority acceptance or repair.

commands.name: author
commands.description: Preview canonical governance proposals from readable Module selectors and schema guidance.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only projection of existing immutable results; no verification execution, certification, authority acceptance or repair.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Serve the versioned read-only inspection protocol over bounded JSON lines.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only projection of existing immutable results; no verification execution, certification, authority acceptance or repair.

commands.name: transition
commands.description: Compare exact subject, intent, authority and governance states without verdict-only causation.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only derived comparison; no approval, state mutation or certification execution.

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Export registered portable evidence or verify it independently offline, without authentication claims.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only inspection or explicit new-output export; no authentication, execution or authorization authority.

commands.name: sarif
commands.description: Project retained findings and scoped claims into SARIF 2.1.0 with explicit presentation losses.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only inspection or explicit new-output export; no authentication, execution or authorization authority.

commands.name: authority
commands.description: Preview protected authority changes against explicitly selected base policy without granting permission or claiming host enforcement.
commands.certification_implications: Read-only preview; no repository-supplied grant, external approval, host mediation or provider enforcement is inferred.
